liveDeploymentDeltaRequired: Build and attest one Mission Control image from the exact reviewed candidate commit; replace only the currently installed application bytes while preserving the existing durable EventStore volume, environment, epoch-5 authority inputs, and rollback runtime.

Install the exact relay package bytes from the same reviewed commit on the already trusted relay; preserve its producer identity, configuration, fence, pacing state, browser ownership, and rollback copy.
Keep persistent submit and capability-test gates disabled and the sender fenced throughout installation and post-install validation.
Do not change requestBound policy fields: the existing enabled policy and trusted relay allowlist activate V6 only when admission explicitly requests IN_BAND_REQUEST_BINDING_V1.

After restart, revalidate liveness, event chain, authority ledger, epoch-5 single-active lease, zero queue, null unresolved admission, clear target transition, null safety halt, and unchanged global pacing before any V6 route is created.
rollbackPlan: Preserve the pre-deployment Mission Control container/image/configuration, relay bytes/configuration, and a transactionally consistent durable-volume backup before installation.
If any invariant or hosted candidate check fails, keep the sender fenced, stop the candidate, and restore the preserved Mission Control and relay versions against the unchanged durable authority.
Never repair rollback by editing SQLite, rewriting events, changing V4/V5 history, creating a second writer, or replaying a provider request.

requestBoundPolicyCoexistence.reason: V6 reuses requestBound.enabled and the trusted relay-producer allowlist. An explicit bindingProtocol selects V6; unchanged admissions continue to create V5.

proposedOneSendLiveAcceptance: Obtain a new explicit consequential authorization covering deployment and one V6 provider send.
Deploy the exact reviewed Mission Control and relay candidate reversibly with the sender fenced and both persistent send gates disabled.
Pass all post-install authority, chain, ledger, lease, queue, transition, safety, and pacing checks before creating a route.
Create exactly one fresh route-schema-v6 request for the same parent outcome and bounded task with IN_BAND_REQUEST_BINDING_V1.
Allocate one fresh provider session and construct the exact canonical binding envelope and one-message GitHub-only prompt.
Obtain one central single-use admission for the exact provider body hash, then durably record the exact trusted pre-send receipt before browser submission.
Release only the bounded sender fence, select GitHub only, and submit exactly one provider message with no MCP, preload, capability, Continue, or Retry action.

Accept success only if the authorized GitHub writer publishes one canonical schema-v5 decision and ingestion validates the exact binding, pre-send receipt, admission, provider lifecycle, one-send timing, target, owner outcome, evidence capsule, and provenance.
On any failure or missing accepted receipt, re-fence immediately, preserve evidence, send nothing else, and do not fall back to V4 or V5.
After accepted V6 proof, continue the existing PM-mediated controller cycle; defer permanent hardening until PM_MEDIATED_LIVE_PROOF_PASS.
